notes.title: Patch Notes 002 Balance!
notes.content:
We have adjusted the experience required for leveling up. This change should allow you to upgrade more quickly and advance much faster.
Passive abilities, such as Auto Tentacles, have been buffed to make them a more viable option.
This includes "No Nut November," which lets you gain additional points without clicking.

Don't forget to check out Devilina coming next month if you already completed Tokyo!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3330750

notes.title: Game is now released! Come, corrupt Tokyo!
notes.content:
Since the demo we improved the game by adding QoL features and improved the progression based on feedback that we got!

Thank you everyone for all the support you have shown us, we are very happy to be working on these games.

Today we also announcing our next Corrupt Them All, called Devilina. More info about her soon!

[h3][b]
Buy Tokyo today![/b][/h3]
